Tuhinur Rahman Chowdhury

  Graduate Research Assistant| Graduate Part Time Instructor | Texas Tech University

I am a PhD student in Agricultural and Applied Economics at Texas Tech University. My research centers on applied econometrics, policy analysis, agricultural labor markets, and rural economic issues, with a focus on using quantitative methods to address real-world challenges. I am especially interested in causal inference, labor economics, and time series analysis. In addition to my research, I serve as a Graduate Part-Time Instructor, teaching undergraduate statistics and helping students build a strong foundation in data analysis and statistical reasoning
